summary:
[  edit  ]
The Audio File In  CHOP  reads audio from files on disk or at  http://  addresses. File types  .mp3 ,  .aif ,  .aiff ,  .au , and  .wav  files are supported. It always outputs time sliced audio data. If you want to record the data, use a  Record CHOP  or  Movie File Out TOP .
See  Audio Movie CHOP  for reading from movie files. See  OSC In CHOP  for receiving audio streams via OSC.
For large files the Audio File In  CHOP  streams the file from disk so loading the entire file into memory is not needed.
It streams files from disk and from  http:  locations (latter copies to local disk first) - It only keeps a few seconds in memory at a time.
The supported audio files are  .mp3 .aif .aiff .wav  and other  audio formats .
It also plays audio-only from any movie files that TouchDesigner supports, like  .mov, .mpg .mp4 . See also the  Audio Movie CHOP  for playing audio from movie files in sync with their video.
Audio files can be dragged/dropped onto TouchDesigner, double-clicked (if preferred), and RMB Open With... TouchDesigner.

parameters.label: File
parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Path  of source.

parameters.label: Reload
parameters.name: reloadpulse
parameters.description: Instantly reload the file from disk.

parameters.label: Play
parameters.name: play
parameters.description: Audio will playback when this is set to 1 and stop when set to 0.

parameters.label: Play Mode
parameters.name: playmode
parameters.description: ⊞  - Specifies the method used to playback the audio, there are 3 options.

parameters.label: Locked to  Timeline
parameters.name: locked
parameters.description: This mode locks the playback position to the timeline. Scrubbing or jumping in the timeline will change the song position accordingly. The parameters Play, Reset, Speed, and Index are disabled in this mode since the timeline is directly tied to playback position.

parameters.label: Specify Index
parameters.name: specify
parameters.description: This mode allows the user to specify a particular position in the song using the Index parameter below. Use this mode for random access to any location in the audio stream.

parameters.label: Sequential
parameters.name: sequential
parameters.description: This mode continually plays regardless of the timeline position (the Index parameter is disabled). Reset and Speed parameters below are enabled to allow some control.

parameters.label: Timecode  Object / CHOP / DAT
parameters.name: timecodeop
parameters.description: This mode allows the user to set the movie index by reference to a timecode in the form of either a  CHOP ,  DAT , or  Timecode Class  object.

parameters.label: Speed
parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: This is a speed multiplier which only works when Play Mode is  Sequential . A value of 1 is the default playback speed. A value of 2 is double speed, 0.5 is half speed and so on. This node can not play audio backwards so negative values will not work well.

parameters.label: Cue
parameters.name: cue
parameters.description: Jumps to Cue Point when set to 1. Only available when Play Mode is Sequential.

parameters.label: Cue  Pulse
parameters.name: cuepulse
parameters.description: Instantly jumps to the Cue  Point .

parameters.label: Cue  Point
parameters.name: cuepoint
parameters.description: Set any index in the song as a point to jump to.

parameters.label: Cue Point Unit
parameters.name: cuepointunit
parameters.description: Units used when setting the Cue Point parameter.

parameters.label: Index
parameters.name: index
parameters.description: This parameter explicitly sets the song position when Play Mode is set to Specify Index. The units menu on the right lets you specify the index in the following units: Index, Frames, or Seconds.

parameters.label: Index Unit
parameters.name: indexunit
parameters.description: Units used for the Index parameter.

parameters.label: Timecode  Object / CHOP / DAT
parameters.name: timecodeop
parameters.description: Set the audio file index with a reference to a timecode. Should be a reference to either a  CHOP  with channels 'hour', 'second', 'minute', 'frame', a  DAT  with a timecode string in its first cell, or a  Timecode Class  object.

parameters.label: Repeat
parameters.name: repeat
parameters.description: ⊞  - Repeats the audio stream when the end is reached.

parameters.label: Trim
parameters.name: trim
parameters.description: Enables the Trim parameters below.

parameters.label: Trim Start
parameters.name: trimstart
parameters.description: Sets an  In  point from the beginning of the audio, allowing you to trim the starting position of the audio stream. The units menu on the right let you specify this position by index, frames, or seconds.

parameters.label: Trim Start Unit
parameters.name: trimstartunit
parameters.description: Units used for the Trim Start parameter.

parameters.label: Trim End
parameters.name: trimend
parameters.description: Sets an  Out  point from the end of the audio, allowing you to trim the ending position of the audio stream. The units menu on the right let you specify this position by index, frames, or seconds.

parameters.label: Trim End Unit
parameters.name: trimendunit
parameters.description: Units used for the Trim End parameter.

parameters.label: Pre-Read Length
parameters.name: prereadlength
parameters.description: The amount of audio to buffer to maintain smooth playback. This will slightly impact memory usage, but does  not  create any delay in the audio.

parameters.label: Pre-Read Length Unit
parameters.name: prereadlengthunit
parameters.description: Units used for the Pre-Read Length parameter.

parameters.label: Open Timeout
parameters.name: opentimeout
parameters.description: The time (in milliseconds) TouchDesigner will wait for the audio file to open. If the Open Timeout time is reached, the Audio File In  CHOP  will stop waiting, and play silence. If the file still isn't opened the next time the  CHOP  cooks, it'll wait again, and do the same. It'll keep doing this until the file is opened, or the open fails.

parameters.label: Mono
parameters.name: mono
parameters.description: Output mono channel only even if file has multiple channels.

parameters.label: Volume
parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Set the level the file is read in at. A setting of 1 is full signal while 0 is muted.

parameters.label: Time Slice
parameters.name: timeslice
parameters.description: Turning this on forces the channels to be " Time Sliced ".  A  Time Slice  is the time between the last cook frame and the current cook frame.

parameters.label: Scope
parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: To determine which channels get affected, some CHOPs use a  Scope  string on the Common page.

parameters.label: Sample Rate  Match
parameters.name: srselect
parameters.description: ⊞  - Handle cases where multiple input CHOPs' sample rates are different. When Resampling occurs, the curves are interpolated according to the Interpolation Method Option, or "Linear" if the Interpolate Options are not available.

parameters.label: Resample At First Input's Rate
parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Use rate of first input to resample others.

parameters.label: Resample At Maximum Rate
parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Resample to the highest sample rate.

parameters.label: Resample At Minimum Rate
parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Resample to the lowest sample rate.

parameters.label: Error If Rates Differ
parameters.name: err
parameters.description: Doesn't accept conflicting sample rates.

parameters.label: Export  Method
parameters.name: exportmethod
parameters.description: ⊞  - This will determine how to connect the  CHOP  channel to the parameter. Refer to the  Export  article for more information.

parameters.label: DAT  Table by Index
parameters.name: datindex
parameters.description: Uses the docked  DAT  table and references the channel via the index of the channel in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: DAT  Table by Name
parameters.name: datname
parameters.description: Uses the docked  DAT  table and references the channel via the name of the channel in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: Channel Name is  Path : Parameter
parameters.name: autoname
parameters.description: The channel is the full destination of where to export to, such has  geo1/transform1:tx .

parameters.label: Export   Root
parameters.name: autoexportroot
parameters.description: This path points to the root node where all of the paths that exporting by  Channel Name is  Path : Parameter   are relative to.

parameters.label: Export  Table
parameters.name: exporttable
parameters.description: The  DAT  used to hold the export information when using the  DAT  Table  Export  Methods (See above).

parameters.label: start
parameters.description: Start of the  CHOP  interval in samples.

parameters.label: length
parameters.description: Number of samples in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: sample_rate
parameters.description: The samplerate of the channels in frames per second.

parameters.label: num_channels
parameters.description: Number of channels in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: time_slice
parameters.description: 1 if  CHOP  is  Time Slice  enabled, 0 otherwise.

parameters.label: export_sernum
parameters.description: A count of how often the export connections have been updated.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.description: type parameter, such as Reset parameter in a  Speed CHOP . A pulse from a CHOP is typically a 0 to 1 to 0 signal in an exported channel.

parameters.description: per-second of a  CHOP . Each CHOP in your network has a sample rate. In contrast, the overall timeline has a  Frame Rate , which is the number of frames to  cook  and display per second, generally your monitor display frequency, default 60.
